title: Language and scenario catalog (frozen v0.1)
description: Authoritative shape of packages/contracts/data/catalog.json. Status: FROZEN v0.1 (Phase 03, 2026-10-20) — the shape is fixed; only capability DATA may change later (Phase 08, and only through a reviewed data change, never a silent flag flip). Capability states exist so that documentation alone never marks a language verified: only `documented` may be true, and even that is documentation evidence, not runtime evidence. The sttCode/ttsCode allowlists mean an undocumented language (for example fr-FR) cannot enter the catalog without a schema change. A scenario may declare named `presets` (for example Team Meeting and Office Communication under the workplace scenario) and, for the `custom` scenario, a transient `customTopic` field that is never persisted.

catalogVersion.description: Draft contract version. Bumped only through a Phase 03-style contract review.

checkedOn.description: Date the catalog was last checked against the reviewed provider documentation.

languages.description: Language entries. The catalog data file is separately checked to list exactly the ten documented realtime languages.

codeMixedModes.description: Code-mixed practice modes are separate from standalone languages, with their own documented codes.

id.description: Stable lowercase identifier (ASCII). Display names may change; ids may not, once published.

languageCode.description: BCP-47 style codes documented for the reviewed realtime STT/TTS endpoints (checked 2026-10-16).

ttsLanguageCode.description: TTS additionally documents the code-mixed Hinglish code hi-en. It must not be sent to STT.

capabilityStates.description: Four independent capability states. Documentation listing is never proof of runtime capability: draft 0.1 requires the last three to be false until genuine checks pass.

documented.description: The reviewed provider documentation lists this capability.

accountEnabled.description: A real provider account has been verified to have this capability enabled.

conversationTested.description: This app completed a genuine conversation-capability check for it.

assessmentValidated.description: This app validated measured-assessment quality (pause/filler/rate evidence) for it.

nativeName.description: Name in the language's own script, so the UI can show readable Indic text.

sourceRefs.description: Ids of entries in the top-level `sources` array.

sttCode.description: The STT code the mixed audio is sent under (for Hinglish, the English entry documents Hindi-English mixed input).

presets.description: Named starting points under this scenario. A preset is chosen instead of the bare scenario and is carried in the session settings as `scenarioPresetId`.

customTopic.description: Whether this scenario needs a transient learner-written topic, and how long it may be. `persisted` is always false: the text is never stored in metrics, logs or caches.
